opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and fastest-fare selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Flights, search a one-way or multi-city trip for given legs, dates and travellers (optionally direct only), sort by Fastest, select the top flight and choose the Flexible ticket.
steps: Open Booking.com and click the Flights tab
Choose trip type (One way / Round trip / Multi-city); tick 'Direct flights only' if required
Clear the default origin and type the origin city; tick the matching airport
Type the destination city in 'Where to?' and tick the matching airport
Open the departure date picker and pick the date
For multi-city, fill the second leg's origin, destination and date
Set the number of adults in the travellers dropdown and click Done
Click Search
Optionally apply filters (direct only, departure time window)
Click the 'Fastest' sort tab
Click 'See flight' on the top result, then 'Select'
Choose the Flexible ticket option and click Next

instances.values: One way, direct only, Bangalore (BLR) → Goa (GOI), 29 Mar 2023, 2 adults, departs 18:00-23:59, Fastest, Flexible ticket
Multi-city, New York (NYC) → Tokyo (TYO) on 1 Jun 2023, then Tokyo → New Delhi (DEL) on 5 Jun 2023, 1 adult, direct only, Fastest, Flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search rental cars for a pick-up/drop-off location, date range and times, then filter by car type, capacity or rental company and sort the results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab (Rental cars)
Type the pick-up location and choose the suggestion
Optionally set a different drop-off location and choose the suggestion
Open the date picker, pick the pick-up and drop-off dates, then click Done
Optionally set the pick-up time and drop-off time
Click Search
Tick filter checkboxes (car type, capacity, rental company)
Optionally change 'Sort by' (e.g., Total Price)

instances.values: Interrupted run: JFK pick-up and drop-off, Apr 3–6 2023, 9:00 am–6:00 pm, filters 2-5 passengers + Luxury, sorted by Total Price
San Francisco, Apr 8–9 2023, default times, filters Avis + Economy

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search cruises by destination, departure port and month, then set the number of guests on the results page.
steps: Open the Carnival homepage
Click 'Sail To' and pick the destination
Optionally click 'Sail From' and pick the departure port
Optionally click 'Dates' and pick the month
Click 'SEARCH CRUISES'
On the results page, open 'Number of Guests', use +/- to set the guest count and close it
Review the results

instances.values: Panama Canal from San Francisco, CA, October 2024
Caribbean, any port and date, guests 2→3→4 (interrupted by Kohl's)

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, open Planned Service Changes, search for a route and optionally pick a date to see planned work for it.
steps: Open new.mta.info
Click 'Planned Work' (or Menu > Planned Service Changes)
Type the route name in 'Search Routes' and pick it from the list
Optionally open the date picker, go to the target month and pick the date
Read the results

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search airport parking for a given airport and optionally a date range and sort order.
steps: Open the SpotHero homepage and click the 'Airport' tab
Type the airport name or code in the search box
Choose the matching airport from the list
Optionally set the parking start and end dates in the date picker
Optionally change the sort dropdown (e.g., Shuttle Time)

instances.values: JFK, Apr 18–20 2023, sorted by Shuttle Time
Dallas Love Field (DAL), no dates shown
